contract: A source-condition review is reusable only for the exact bound proposed plan. Changing a displayed segment in that plan changes conditionBinding; the prior blind/compare receipt is rejected and a current fresh receipt is required.

cases.changedPlan: conditionBinding SHA changes and exactly one fresh CONDITIONS review is run
cases.exactTarget: plan A source condition AB=5 maps display segment AB; plan B preserves the condition but changes displayed segment to AC

focused.command: node --test --test-name-pattern 'changed proposed visual plan invalidates' archive/tools/geometry-equation/tests/p1-boundaries.test.mjs (10 repetitions)

limits: Contract/provider harness only; no external provider call or actual Archive render.
This closes explicit proposal-plan invalidation; full source/image/provider/observer and cache invalidation variants remain open.
